_README: THE SAFE CHUNK BAND PER VOICE, in characters. THIS FILE IS THE ONE TO EDIT.
min  the packer's MERGE FLOOR - short paragraphs travel together until a group reaches it
max  the packer's CAP        - a group may grow to here, and no chunk exceeds it
Every chunk a book renders falls between the two, except text that cannot be merged with
anything (a chapter heading, a list item, a scene-final line) - those are walls and stand alone.
WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM: a length sweep of the promoted checkpoint across the whole
spectrum. The band is where that checkpoint makes the fewest mistakes, and promotion writes it
here. Do NOT guess one from the training corpus - a rule derived from the corpus p25 was wrong
in production within a day (orpheus-finetune HIGGS_FIELD_NOTES 4n.37.19-21).
These OVERRIDE safeMinChars/safeMaxChars in higgs-models.json, which keeps the evidence notes.
A voice may add an 'mlx' or 'served' block to give one arm its own band; otherwise both arms
share the top-level pair. max may never exceed that arm's maxChars, and min must sit below max -
both refused by name, here and in narrator's engine/higgs/config.py.
THE MEASUREMENTS BEHIND EACH BAND live in higgs-safe-bands-evidence.md beside this file: the per-rung
failure curve, what every column means, and the four failure modes (cov / short / long / error).
JSON takes no comments, so the evidence lives there instead of here.

thirdreich._note: MEASURED 2026-09-09, full 4-seed ladder (runs/tr_ladder_full, 620 renders, n=32/rung), pooled by ACTUAL character count rather than rung label: 500-700 = 2/68 = 2.9% (95% hi 10.1%), the best of every candidate. By actual chars: 450-500 0/20, 500-600 2/24 = 8.3%, 600-700 0/44 = 0.0%, 700-800 5/40 = 12.5%, 800-900 6/32 = 18.8%, 900-1000 1/32. So the cap is 700 (chunks up to 699): 700-800 is a real 12.5% zone and 800-900 is worse at 18.8%. WHY NOT 500-800, which band.py ranked first: band.py pools by RUNG LABEL, and a rung is a target +/-12%, so its 'rung 800' prompts actually span 712-823 and straddle the cliff. Pooling by the character count the packer really emits is the faithful measure and it disagrees. This also supersedes the same morning's 800->1000 raise, which came from a 2-seed sweep (n=16/rung) whose 6.2% at 900/1000 was the noise floor - at n=32 those rungs measure 16%. Matches production: Owen's truncations at a 700 target, and Mac failures at 323/502/634. maxChars stays 1000; a cap above the band is legal and the band is what the packer uses. Full curve and column glossary: higgs-safe-bands-evidence.md. PREVIOUS: 500-800.
